text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Shoot... I was doing mountain 
runs and completely lost track of time...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's that? Up ahead... is that a 
light?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: This place is...

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text: This is—the sanctuary of the divine.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa! What's with this old lady!?

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
Within the sacred realm――don the divine 
raiment.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What's going on here...? What in the 
world is happening?

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross. No, or perhaps— should I 
call you Nishikino Cross?

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
Let us see the true shape of thy soul. And 
discover which Umamusume shares a spirit 
like thine.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What're ya talkin' about? An Umamusume 
with a... similar soul?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Like Oguri? She's plenty hungry too. You 
don't gotta go outta your way to tell me 
that...

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
Do not gaze... upon the surface... The one 
who resembles you—first, is this 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hey, Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That's right... Indeed... We are... alike.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
――!? Rudolf...!? Ya sayin'... she looks 
like her?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's completely wrong! Nothing about it 
even remotely resembles the real thing...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, I actually think we're pretty 
similar, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
She looks so sleek when winning, but 
honestly... she actually has a super 
fierce competitive streak, y'know?♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Teio. Even you...? What are ya talkin' 
about?

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
There's also the wild "King of 
Destruction." And then...

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume whose soul shape most 
closely resembles yours is――

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hayahide...? You and... me...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the two of us are like an equation. 
In other words—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
They are tied together with an equals 
sign. This is a mathematical formula... A 
formula of the soul...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Stop talking nonsense! Snap out of it! I 
don't get formulas or equations at all!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The one who's like me is Oguri! And Inari 
too, maybe...!

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
That is—merely on the surface. The abyss 
of the soul cannot be measured by such 
metrics. Never.

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text: Accept it. Your—true way of being!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek!! Y-You've gotta be kidding me!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(No good! Listening to this gal's gonna 
mess with my head. But...)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(Her words are stuck in my head, and they 
won't leave! What should I do...?!)
choice_data_list: I'll forget it with some intense training.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...That's it! Training. As soon as I get 
back, I'll train like crazy and—"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Forget everythin'. This is a dream. A 
bad... bad dream!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Deyaaaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* Trainer. How was that run 
just now?

Tamamo Cross ran differently today. Yes... 
almost as if she were running away from 
something at full speed...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm? Are you in the middle of training?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the intrusion, Tamamo-san. Would 
you mind if I used the edge of the course?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It's heeeere!!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Tamamo-san...?! What do you mean by 
'it came out'...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeek!! No matter how much I run, my 
head, my heaaaad!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? It's not so big that it messes up 
your sense of perspective! Wait, 
Tamamo-san!

Tamamo Cross ran away at full speed. 
Pale-faced, the speed at which she fled 
was truly extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...That's it! I can't stay here. As soon 
as possible..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Run before you get swallowed up!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Gyowaaaaaaaaaaah!! Save meeeeee!!!!!
A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* Trainer. How was it? What was 
my slope time?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Still... what's that supposed to mean?
choice_data_list: My downhill times are getting faster...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What're ya timin'? Timin' the 
downhill ain't gonna do any good...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ah... but, oh, right.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Nah, it's just... the other day, I was 
made to do downhill training, you see.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I went through hell, but I might've gotten 
the hang of it. Guess good things do 
happen.

I wasn't sure what had happened. However, 
in exchange for having a rough time, it 
seemed she had gained something from it.
